messages:
mina: quick thought  we keep seeing remediations fall through the cracks. propose two small changes: required 24h check in PM template + a lightweight 'stale after 50% SLO' auto-escalation.

devin: yup, make 24h mandatory. also prefer 2-week IC rotation (mon 09:00 UTC) so followups have continuity.

mina: agree on 2-week rotation. for the auto-escalation: when a remediation hits 50% of its SLO without verification, ops-bot pings owner and oncall-lead and creates an "unblock" placeholder if status is Blocked.

ops-bot: i can do: `@ops-bot watch <ticket-id> 50% notify:owner,oncall-lead escalate-if:blocked,blocked-count:2`. needs jira integration.

oncall-lead: small process ask: PM authors must nominate an owner and acceptance criteria at closure. we'll pilot for 4 weeks on P1/P2 incidents.

devin: dashboard metrics to add: reopen-rate, avg time to verification, repeat-component count (90d). alert when repeat-component >=3.

mina: i'll draft the PR with template changes, ops-bot commands, rotation roster, and metric definitions. can @devin and @oncall-lead review?

devin: happy to.

oncall-lead: will run the 4-week pilot and gather feedback.

mina: plan: PR by EOD. merge after 48h if no objections. goal: fewer orphaned remediations and faster detection of recurring components. :thumbsup:
